applicability: Whole-subject review answers read by one mounted review surface.
conditions: The answer was admitted, is whole rather than a page, and carried no refresh identity.
The review store is bounded LRU at 24 answers and lives only as long as the mounted surface.
Whole-review reuse requires no explicit review-input invalidation since admission; memoryChanged advances inputEpoch, clears the review store and requests a refresh.
exclusions: Paged and roster-continuation reads, which stay owned by the read cycle.
Refusals and failures, which are always asked again.
Re-validating a moved live candidate on return; the reader's refresh re-asks (O-R1-1, by design).
The former unconditional no-request promise for a same-tree pair after explicit memory-input invalidation; an old input epoch is not a reusable answer.
statement: Within an unchanged retained comparison generation and review-input epoch, admitted whole-subject reviews are reused on return. Refresh re-asks; explicit memory-input invalidation clears review reuse and rejects old-epoch completions, while a changed comparison generation clears the bounded surface-owned review store. Refusals and failures are not retained.
